associations.rationale: The type only presents Tor as an AddCommGrp-valued construction and does not state its projective-resolution homology characterization.
The type gives a functorial Tor construction but does not identify its values with homology of a tensored resolution.
This is the tensor functor used in the construction, a prerequisite rather than the Tor-homology statement itself.
The type directly gives an isomorphism from Tor to the homology of a projective resolution after applying the tensor-right functor.
